chapter: Gene Mayl, Teddy Buckner and the Dixie Flies
title: Offer from Gene Mayl's Rhythm Kings in Dayton
summary: Gene Mayl visited Los Angeles with an offer and Joe moved to Dayton, Ohio, near his wife Helen's family.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: I was wondering where they came into it. So you've left Ory now. Let's progress on a bit.
You've left Ory. Then you went to where? Ohio?

Gene came to see me. Gene was in Los Angeles, and he had heard that I had left the Ory band. I didn't know what he came here for, what the occasion was. They came, they'd been playing, and they were here. And he came and asked did I want the job, and he made me a pretty good offer. And one reason why I took it... The money really wasn't that good; it was adequate. Helen's people...

Yes. They was livin' in Ohio, and Helen says, "Well, that will be close to home," and she wanted to go home anyway, and I said, "Well, that will be a nice trip for us." I went there for two weeks, stayed a year or so maybe.
What year did you marry Helen?
Just because we introduced her, and people might wonder who you're talking about.
